_comment._general: This is an EXAMPLE parameters file with placeholder values only — hence the .example.json name. Copy it to main.parameters.json, fill in real values, and NEVER commit that copy (see infra/README.md, which notes it should be gitignored). The '_comment' object itself is not a real deployment parameter; az deployment group create/what-if ignores unrecognized top-level keys and only reads 'parameters'.
_comment.location: Azure region for every resource this template creates (Log Analytics, Container Apps environment, container app, managed identity). Does not affect the existing ACR/Key Vault, which keep whatever region they already have.
_comment.acrName: Name of the existing Azure Container Registry (created manually per infra/README.md step 2 — this template never creates it). Must be in the same resource group you deploy this template into: the AcrPull role assignment is an extension resource, and Azure only lets one target a resource inside the deployment's own resource group.
_comment.keyVaultName: Name of the existing Key Vault holding the 'azure-client-secret' secret (created manually per infra/README.md step 2 — this template never creates it). Same same-resource-group requirement as acrName, for the same reason (the Key Vault Secrets User role assignment).
_comment.imageRepository: Repository name inside the ACR. 'iam-mcp' matches what infra/README.md's manual bring-up and .github/workflows/deploy.yml both build and push under.
_comment.imageTag: The image tag to deploy. IMPORTANT: if you're re-running this template against an app that CI has already deployed to, read the currently-live tag first (az containerapp show ... --query "properties.template.containers[0].image") and pass that here — otherwise you will roll the running app back to whatever tag this file happens to have. See infra/README.md's 'image-tag drift trap'.
_comment.minReplicas: Minimum replica count. Left at 1 (this template's default) unless you have a specific reason to change it — see main.bicep's parameter description for why 0 is a real user-facing regression here, not just a cost optimization.
_comment.maxReplicas: Maximum replica count. Left at 1 (this template's default) — raising this needs a real multi-replica session story first (see main.bicep's parameter description).
_comment.logRetentionDays: Log Analytics retention in days for the audit trail. 90 is the deliberate policy default; only override if that policy changes.
_comment.azureTenantId: Primary Entra tenant GUID (AZURE_TENANT_ID). Not secret, but still a real tenant identifier — this is exactly why the real, filled-in parameters file must never be committed.
_comment.azureClientId: The multi-tenant app registration's client ID (AZURE_CLIENT_ID). Not secret.
_comment.azureTenantId2: Optional second tenant GUID (AZURE_TENANT_ID_2). Leave as an empty string to run single-tenant. Must be set together with azureTenantDisplayName2 — the app treats these as a pair.
_comment.azureTenantDisplayName2: Optional second tenant display name (AZURE_TENANT_DISPLAYNAME_2). Must be set together with azureTenantId2.
_comment.mcpInboundTenantId: Optional inbound caller-auth config: expected tenant ID for inbound MCP callers. Leave blank if inbound auth isn't configured yet.
_comment.mcpInboundAudiences: Optional inbound caller-auth config: accepted audiences (comma-separated, per the app's own parsing).
_comment.mcpRequiredScope: Optional inbound caller-auth config: required scope/role claim.
_comment.mcpCanonicalResource: Optional inbound caller-auth config: canonical resource identifier the app presents itself as.
